entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve startvs/startvscode scripts #64409
  • Build from source instructions need to be updated for VS 2026 #64405
  • Perf improvement: updates #64402
  • Document highlights: Syntax node is not within syntax tree #64398
  • Setting the OpenAPI spec version not working #64397
    Backlog
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi: The route template cannot start with a '~' character #64395
    Backlog
  • Security policy should probably not be listing an e-mail address #64393
  • [Blazor] InputFile should implement dispose pattern #64392
    Backlog
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #64391
  • Isolated CSS Files are not applied, unable to restore behaviour that originally worked with CSS files #64390

Closed

  • Blazor WASM .Net 10 app publish with CompressionEnabled set false still creates .br, .gz files #64396
  • XmlCommentOperationTransformer null reference exception #63757
  • OpenAPI Generation No Longer Groups Endpoints Using WithGroupName #64335
    Backlog
  • Blazor reconnection issue on IIS Web Garden. #64385
  • Blazor WebAssembly Standalone template incorrectly fingerprints _framework runtime files when OverrideHtmlAssetPlaceholders=true (VS 2026 / .NET 10) #64359

PullRequests

Created

  • Update startvs/startvscode scripts to use ".NET" terminology #64410
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix OpenAPI generator crash on routes starting with '~' #64408
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add Visual Studio 2026 support to InstallVisualStudio.ps1 #64406
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • OpenAPI: Fix duplicate xml documentation ids for Generic properties and references #64404
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Fix typo in IEndpointSelectorPolicy documentation #64403
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Obsolete IdentityUserContext.SchemaVersion property #64400
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add page reload on circuit resume failure for remote pauses #64399
    Attention: Shared Code Modified

Merged

  • Fix shared code policy triggering on PRs with zero file changes #64407
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview1
  • [release/10.0] Enable Identity telemetry by instantiating metrics classes directly #64271
    Servicing-approved, area-identity, 10.0.1
  • [release/10.0] Fix ModelMetadata null reference exception in emitted XMLComment transformers #64401
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1
  • Add Changelog for SignalR typescript client #63392
    area-signalr, pending-ci-rerun, 11.0-preview1
  • Clean up CSS for ReconnectModal component #64258
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview1
  • OpenAPI: Fix ModelMetadata null reference exception in emitted XMLComment transformers #63872
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun, 11.0-preview1
  • Fix case-insensitive group name matching in OpenAPI document filtering #64353
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • OpenAPI: Fix component $ref registration into the workspace so references get resolved correctly #64109
    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Add page reload when resuming Blazor circuit fails #64290
    area-blazor
  • feat: "Spanify" DataProtector with IBufferWriter<byte> #64262
    area-dataprotection
  • Add missing clearing of pooled arrays #63710
    area-blazor, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
